css: .essdee-consumption{border:1px solid #666;color:#222;font-size:11px}.essdee-consumption *{box-sizing:border-box}.essdee-consumption__header{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr;padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #666}.essdee-consumption__title{font-size:20px;font-weight:600}.essdee-consumption h3{font-size:14px;margin:10px 8px 4px}.essdee-consumption table{border-collapse:collapse;margin:0;width:100%}.essdee-consumption th,.essdee-consumption td{border:1px solid #888;padding:5px!important;vertical-align:top}.essdee-consumption th{background:#f1f3f5;font-weight:600}.essdee-consumption__empty{padding:12px;text-align:center;color:#666}
name: Essdee Consumption Sheet
